title: Flow 04修复计划反向技术评审

scope.defect: Flow 04 positive grounded practice generation retry contract

review_decisions.reason: The first S2 choice may be model variance. The deterministic defects are the missing Practice contract and the byte-identical no-op retry messages.
A schema-exact system-level contract is the minimum change matching the existing server validator.
Use a bounded server-generated practice_retry_feedback object, not free-form metadata guidance.
Capture messages passed to a fake DeepSeek client; builder-only assertions are insufficient.
Keep the current two-candidate loop and reuse the same request-local evidence and spans.
8F did not confirm an evidence-scope or retriever defect.
The model must emit the corrected source/span; the server may validate or reject but never silently rewrite.
Two product files and one test file are sufficient.
Add actual DeepSeek payload, all four external types, and exact Flow 03/08 compatibility nodes.
S1 and S2 must coexist in the same run and a failed created run cannot be replaced by a later successful run.
Flow 08 uses GroundedSpanAnswer/upload citation paths; no direct same-source evidence exists.

deterministic: build_structured_messages has no GroundedPracticeGuide-specific contract branch
Practice retry metadata is not consumed by the prompt builder
Attempt 0 and attempt 1 actual message SHA-256 values are identical
The first Guard failure tuple is not propagated to attempt 1
confirmed_root_cause.not_deterministic_root_cause: The model's first selection of distractor S2
confirmed_root_cause.trigger_condition: Target S1 and semantically related distractor S2 are both visible

forbidden_files_and_surfaces: knowledge fixtures outside the allowed test file

backend/llm/prompts.py: Place the fixed seven-field, one-server-span, independent-support, no-cross-span, no-proposal, and untrusted-evidence rules in messages[0].content.
Keep question, evidence text, and span text in an explicitly untrusted user-data section.
Render only validated server practice_retry_feedback in the attempt-1 system correction section.
Do not consume arbitrary free-form grounded_retry_guidance for Practice.
backend/agent/orchestrator.py: Capture only the first Guard failure in a request-local variable.
Build practice_retry_feedback with error_code, practice_field, ordinal, source_id, and evidence_span_id.
Validate enum, regex, bounds, current-request membership, and source/span ownership before passing feedback.
Do not persist claim text, raw candidate, full evidence, full prompt, exception objects, or secrets.
Keep exactly two candidate iterations and reuse the same hydrated evidence and spans.
Never rewrite a candidate's source/span; validate, bind, render, or abstain only.

fields.practice_field: one of the seven GroundedPracticeGuide fields
fields.evidence_span_id: existing current-request span owned by source_id

retry_feedback_contract.model_instruction: Do not reuse the rejected source/span for the same unsupported or irrelevant claim; select a legal relevant span or reduce the claim to one extractive atomic fact fully supported by one span.

new_or_revised_test_nodes: parameterized mixed course plus paper/standard/vulnerability/project regression in tests/test_practice_grounding_contract.py

fresh_isolated_full_pytest.skips_xfails_warnings: reported separately and not counted as passed; no unexplained new skip

command_8J_gate.transport_recovery: Read isolated run/trace/database first; resubmit only if no run was created, and retain the recovery record.
command_8J_gate.positive_expected: COMPLETED with seven fields, six ordered steps, relevant verified source/span bindings, DeepSeek provider, and fallback_used=false
command_8J_gate.if_retry_occurs: Save distinct hashes, bounded feedback, at most two candidates, and zero upstream replay
command_8J_gate.if_first_candidate_passes: Do not force a browser failure; reference the deterministic 8I fake-client retry test

security_invariants: Citation Guard and Practice Guard remain fail closed with unchanged thresholds.
GroundedPracticeGuide schema, public API, and database schema remain unchanged.
The model proposes source/span and the server never silently corrects it.
Course authorization, INDEXED checks, and cross-course isolation remain unchanged.
Trusted external evidence still requires current-run provenance and no refetch.
Full chunks, full prompts, and raw candidates never enter persistent state, logs, traces, API output, or diagnostics.
Prompt injection in evidence cannot override the system-level Practice contract or retry correction.
Template fallback cannot turn a DeepSeek Practice failure into success.
rollback: Revert only the 8I changes in the three allowlisted files; preserve the 8D-S2 mixed-evidence implementation and historical evidence. No migration is required.
